description: Engineering backlog worked by the autonomous agent (scripts/agent/run.mjs), one task per run. Statuses: pending | done | blocked. Add tasks freely; the agent picks the first pending task whose dependsOn are all done.

tasks.title: Centralized error handling with AppError and 404 handler
tasks.description: Introduce an AppError class (status, message, optional details) in src/utils/AppError.js and a central error middleware in src/middleware/errorHandler.js. Add a notFound middleware for unknown routes. Wire both in createApp, replacing the inline error handler. Unexpected errors must return a generic 500 without leaking err.message.
acceptanceCriteria: Unknown routes return 404 { error: 'Not found' }
Thrown AppError(409, 'x') returns 409 { error: 'x' } (and details when provided)
Unexpected errors return 500 { error: 'Internal server error' } and do NOT include the original error message
Malformed JSON bodies return 400 instead of 500

tasks.title: Validate registration input with zod
tasks.description: Add a reusable validate(schema) middleware (src/middleware/validate.js) and a registration schema (src/validators/userValidators.js). Username 3-50 chars [a-zA-Z0-9_], valid email (normalized to lowercase), password 8-128 chars with at least one letter and one number. Apply to POST /api/users/register.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid payloads return 400 { error: 'Validation failed', details: [{ field, message }] }
No database query is issued for invalid payloads
Email is lowercased before the uniqueness check and insert
Valid payloads still register successfully

tasks.title: JWT login endpoint
tasks.description: Add POST /api/users/login accepting { email, password }. Verify with bcrypt, issue an HS256 JWT (sub = user id, username claim, 1h expiry) signed with process.env.JWT_SECRET. Put token logic in src/services/tokenService.js. Validate input with the existing validate middleware.
acceptanceCriteria: Correct credentials return 200 { token, user } without the password hash
Wrong password and unknown email both return 401 with the same generic message (no user enumeration)
Token verifies with JWT_SECRET and has sub, username and exp claims
Missing JWT_SECRET causes a 500, never an unsigned or default-secret token

tasks.title: requireAuth middleware and GET /api/users/me
tasks.description: Add src/middleware/requireAuth.js that verifies 'Authorization: Bearer <jwt>' using tokenService and sets req.user = { id, username }. Add GET /api/users/me returning the current user from the database.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing, malformed, expired or wrongly-signed tokens return 401
Valid token sets req.user and /me returns { user } from the DB
/me returns 404 if the user no longer exists

tasks.title: Create auctions (POST /api/auctions)
tasks.description: Add an auctions router/controller. POST /api/auctions (requireAuth) with { title, description?, startPrice, endsAt }. Validate: title 3-100 chars, startPrice > 0 with max 2 decimals, endsAt ISO date at least 1 minute in the future. Insert with seller_id = req.user.id, current_price = start_price, status 'ACTIVE'. Mount at /api/auctions.
acceptanceCriteria: 201 { auction } with camelCase fields on success
401 without a token, 400 with field details on invalid input
INSERT is parameterized and uses the authenticated user as seller

tasks.title: List and fetch auctions with pagination
tasks.description: GET /api/auctions with ?status=ACTIVE|PENDING|CLOSED, ?limit (1-100, default 20) and ?cursor (id-based keyset pagination, ordered by id DESC). GET /api/auctions/:id returns one auction. Both public.
acceptanceCriteria: List returns { auctions, pagination: { nextCursor } } and nextCursor is null on the last page
Invalid status/limit/cursor returns 400
Unknown or non-numeric id returns 404 / 400 respectively
Pagination uses WHERE id < $cursor, not OFFSET

tasks.title: Place bids with row-level locking
tasks.description: Add a bids table to schema.sql (id, auction_id FK, bidder_id FK, amount NUMERIC(12,2), created_at; index on (auction_id, amount DESC)). POST /api/auctions/:id/bids (requireAuth) { amount }. In ONE transaction: SELECT the auction FOR UPDATE, reject if not ACTIVE or ends_at passed (409), reject seller bidding on own auction (403), require amount >= current_price + minimum increment (max(1.00, 5% of current_price)) else 409, insert bid, update current_price, COMMIT. ROLLBACK on any error and always release the client.
acceptanceCriteria: Uses db.connect(), BEGIN, SELECT ... FOR UPDATE, COMMIT; ROLLBACK on every failure path
Client is released on success and on failure
Correct status codes for closed auction, own auction, too-low bid, unknown auction
201 { bid, auction: { currentPrice } } on success

tasks.title: Bid history endpoint
tasks.description: GET /api/auctions/:id/bids returning bids newest first with bidder username (JOIN users), limit 1-100 default 50, plus the current highest bid.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns { bids, highestBid } with no user emails or hashes
404 for unknown auction, 400 for invalid id/limit

tasks.title: Token-bucket rate limiter for auth and bidding
tasks.description: Implement an in-memory token bucket in src/middleware/rateLimit.js (no dependencies): createRateLimiter({ capacity, refillPerSecond, key: req => string, now?: () => ms }). Apply to POST /login (by IP) and POST bids (by user id). Inject `now` so tests are deterministic without sleeping.
acceptanceCriteria: Requests beyond capacity get 429 with a Retry-After header
Tokens refill over time (tested via injected clock)
Buckets are independent per key
Stale buckets are evicted so memory does not grow unbounded

tasks.title: Request IDs and structured access logs
tasks.description: Middleware that assigns each request an id (honor an incoming X-Request-Id if it is a safe <=64 char token, else crypto.randomUUID()), echoes it in the X-Request-Id response header, and logs one JSON line per request on finish: { requestId, method, path, status, durationMs }. Include requestId in 500 error responses.
acceptanceCriteria: Every response has X-Request-Id
Unsafe incoming ids are replaced
One JSON log line per request with the documented fields
500 responses include requestId

tasks.title: Close expired auctions
tasks.description: Add src/services/auctionCloser.js exporting closeExpiredAuctions({ db, now }) that, in a transaction, marks ACTIVE auctions with ends_at <= now as CLOSED and returns [{ auctionId, winnerId, winningAmount }] using the highest bid (or null winner). Add POST /api/admin/auctions/close-expired protected by an X-Admin-Token header compared with crypto.timingSafeEqual against process.env.ADMIN_TOKEN.
acceptanceCriteria: Only ACTIVE + expired auctions are closed (verified via SQL params)
Winner is the highest bidder; auctions without bids close with winnerId null
Admin endpoint returns 401 for missing/wrong token, uses timingSafeEqual
Transaction is rolled back on error

tasks.title: Liveness vs readiness probes
tasks.description: Keep GET /health as liveness. Add GET /health/ready that returns 200 when SELECT 1 succeeds within 1 second and 503 otherwise (use Promise.race with a timer that is cleared). Kubernetes-style.
acceptanceCriteria: /health/ready returns 200 when the DB responds and 503 when it errors
A DB call that never resolves yields 503 within ~1s and leaves no dangling timer
Existing /health behavior unchanged
